crop.notes: East St. Louis column; only the first item mentions Allen.

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Democrat noted that F. C. Cox of the East St. Louis stock yards, having won over $100 betting on Tom Allen on the 23d, had taken a trip to Louisville.

metadata.notes: Running head reads 'The St. Louis Democrat: St. Louis, Friday, September 26, 1873' with the masthead 'Daily Democrat' (before the May 1875 merger, so not yet the Globe-Democrat).

notes: A betting aside on Allen's fight of September 23, 1873; the opponent is not named in the clipping, so no fact recorded.
